Variants.Content: The Fordley family is based in Tengshi Town and is a local vassal at the intersection of roads and rivers in the Reach. The market, ferry, inn and surrounding farms in Tengshi Town allow the family to participate in trade travel, food and local magistrates; it is not as gorgeous as Highgarden, but it is often the first to feel the changes in the Reach when armies and trucks pass by. Fudley did not base his reputation on conquering the old king or owning a huge port, but maintained his position among manors, knights, marriages and supplying food to his superiors on time. The power of the river princes is often obscured by roses, but a family like Fu Deli supports the real fleets, harvests and roads.

The River Bend nobles regarded Fu Deli as a small but stable root in the local soil. Such a house is not often the center of song, but it can be useful when Highgarden needs food and knights; its political weight comes from continued fulfillment of obligations, not overnight glory.

The people of Fu Deli are more concerned about mills, barns and roads. Merchants hope that their wheels will not get stuck in the mud, and farmers hope that taxes will not be collected before the harvest; if the lord keeps these ordinary orders, the family name will take root in the local area and last longer than the praise at the noble banquet.
Entry Footly Entry Footly The family crest is just a facade, the real weight of the family is whether they can protect their fiefdom, honor their engagements, and rally people in times of crisis.
Entry Footly Entry Footly Family reputation ultimately comes down to specific people and specific orders.

Entry Footly Entry Footly The ancestors of a family can be praised, or they can become a shackles for future generations; the older the bloodline, the more old debts the successors are required to bear.
Entry Footly Entry Footly They may not remember the complete family tree, but they remember which family opened a granary in the winter and which family drove the refugees back into the snow.
